programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Hayman's Way
programme.desc: Follow David Hayman as he unearths the people and places that make Scotland unique.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: On this trip we will visit the Canadian mountains of Mont Tremblant. We will make an exciting expedition, and we will have many ways to mobilize. We will ride and drive a sled pulled by dogs, climb the cable car to reach the top and fly by helicopter over the snowy mountains. Then we go to the enigmatic city of Budapest considered worldwide as one of the most beautiful cities in Europe. With a history that goes back to the first century before the common era, full of an original and elegant culture. We will visit its museums and get delighted with its architecture, product of a diversity of styles. Finally, we will show off our movements by dancing Flamenco in Seville, Spain, where we will see the most beautiful structures of the city, including the Torre del Oro, the Real Palacio de Alcazar and enjoy the exquisite Spanish cuisine.

programme.desc: In this episode Phillip introduces us to Singapore, a hub for culinary innovation and gains some insight into the current culinary scene from food critic and blogger Evelyn Chen and we’re introduced to some of the master chefs to be featured in this series.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode Phillip continues his culinary tour of Singapore, from local street markets to some of the best Singapore has to offer with sneak peaks into some of the kitchens we’ll be visiting over the course of the series.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip joins old friend, Ryan Clift, chef-owner of the newly located Tippling Club, number 23 on the San Pellegrino Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants List and known for it’s modern gastronomy and specialty cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We pick up where we left off in episode one in the kitchen at Tippling Club with Ryan and the preparation of more of his signature dishes, a 10-course degustation menu and a signature cocktail pairing.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip takes us to Spanish restaurant Catalunya, one of Wine & Dine Singapore’s top restaurants in 2013, helmed by Executive Chef Alain Devahive Toloso, previously of Michelin starred elBulli, to see just what makes this restaurant so special.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Voted Singapore’s Best New Restaurant for 2104, Bacchanalia and Executive Chef Ivan Brehm are next on Phillip’s culinary tour of Singapore as we explore their signature dishes in the kitchen and at the Chef’s table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode we join Phillip at celebrity Chef Wolfgang Puck’s Singapore outpost of his critically acclaimed, award-winning, modern steakhouse in Beverly Hills where joins US native, Executive Chef Joshua Brown in the kitchen.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip is welcomed to another celebrity chef outlet, Daniel Boulud’s DB Bistro where the classic Parisian bistro is reinterpreted under Executive Chef, American Jonathan Kinsella’s watchful eye.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip steps into famed Japanese celebrity Chef Tetsuya Wakuda’s second outlet, outside the original in Sydney, Waku Ghin at Marina Bay Sands Resort and Casino, voted number 7 in the coveted San Pellegrino World’s 50 Best Restaurants list.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode Phillip visits British celebrity Michelin star chef, Jason Atherton-helmed Pollen in the Flower Dome at the Gardens by the Bay, voted one of Wine & Dine Singapore’s Top Restaurants.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Ranked number 43 on the San Pellegrino Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants 2014 list, Phillip takes viewers to Gunther’s, a stand-out modern French restaurant helmed by Belgian Chef Gunther Hubrechsen where produce is king.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode Phillip visits JAAN, voted 17th on this year’s San Pellegrino Asia’s 50 Best Restaurants, helmed by the young, talented French Executive Chef Julien Royer.
